sentences.text: The genus Heliadornis was formally described by Olson in 1985.
Scientists have recognized two distinct species within this genus.
Remains of the species Heliadornis ashbyi have been found in Maryland, United States, and Antwerp province, Belgium.
Fossils of Heliadornis ashbyi from Belgium were discovered on the Brussels–Antwerp motorway between Berchem and Wilrijk.
The species Heliadornis paratethydicus was described from Upper Miocene strata in Vösendorf, Austria.
Heliadornis belongs to the family Phaethontidae.
This bird lived during the Miocene epoch, specifically between 15.98 and 11.63 million years ago.
It inhabited temperate climates across the globe.
